# contentful_spaces (Data Source)

Retrieves all Contentful Spaces accessible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_spaces" "accessible" {
  organization_id = var.contentful_organization_id
}

# Omit organization_id to discover Spaces across all accessible organizations.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization to list spaces from. Omitted lists spaces from all accessible organizations.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform lookup identifier: `spaces` without organization scope, otherwise `organizations/organization_id/spaces`.
- `spaces` (Attributes List) Spaces accessible to the account, ordered lexicographically by `space_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spaces))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--spaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spaces`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the space.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization containing the space.
- `space_id` (String) System ID of the space.
